type WithFallback<O, Z, P extends (Z extends true ? keyof O : keyof O | 'fallback')> = P;
type OneBranch<O, Z, P extends (Z extends true ? keyof O : never)> = P;
type TestsOpaqueValue<O, Z, P extends (Z extends true ? keyof O : O)> = P;
type DifferentKeys<O, Z, P extends (Z extends true ? keyof O : 'other')> = P;
type Wrong<T, K extends keyof T, Z> = T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? WithFallback<T[K], Z, 'fallback'> : never;
type Missing<T, K extends keyof T, Z> = T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? WithFallback<T[K], Z, 'missing'> : never;
type Absent<T, K extends keyof T, Z> = T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? OneBranch<T[K], Z, 'key'> : never;
type WrongPart<T, K extends keyof T, Z> = T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? TestsOpaqueValue<T[K], Z, 'key'> : never;
type Either<T, K extends keyof T, Z> = T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? DifferentKeys<T[K], Z, 'key'> : never;
type Distributive<O, Z, P extends (Z extends true ? keyof O | Z : keyof O)> = P;
type Inferred<O, Z, P extends (Z extends infer W ? keyof O : keyof O)> = P;
type UsesCheck<T, K extends keyof T, Z> =
  T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? Distributive<T[K], Z, 'key'> : never;
type UsesInfer<T, K extends keyof T, Z> =
  T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? Inferred<T[K], Z, 'key'> : never;
